description: A triage plan: the steps RepoMind will run, in order, the last one post_comment.

steps.description: The steps, in the order they run.

action.description: What the step does, in words.

tool.description: The one tool this step calls, from the tool list.

args_json.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object encoded as a string. Write "$fill" for any value that depends on an earlier step's result.

depends_on.description: The ids of earlier steps whose results this step uses.

expected_result.description: What the tool returns when the step worked.

status.description: pending when planned; the executor updates it.
